method: Reviewed the publisher-indexed Appendix B text of Jalandoon (2019) and compared its source-reported coordinates with the already-reviewed 2024 Limbago et al. station table. The publisher PDF could not be opened directly during this follow-up because the request timed out; no local copy was downloaded or retained. Coordinates are preserved verbatim as displayed in the publisher-indexed table, not converted into app geometry.

sourceStationCoordinates.coordinateRole: Source-reported sampling substations, not channel vertices or public app points.
sourceStationCoordinates.samplingPeriod: January–March 2018, as recorded in the prior source review.
sourceStationCoordinates.sourceTable: Appendix B, Location and Samples Collected at Maragondon River.

crossStudyComparison.other2024Stations: The 2024 midstream and downstream coordinates do not exactly match the 2019 table's corresponding labelled stations.
crossStudyComparison.interpretation: The exact upstream-coordinate match supports a shared or reused station coordinate. The 2024 article cites Jalandoon (2018), so this is not independent corroboration of the 2019 fish identification or a separate species record. Keep the 2019 Oreochromis niloticus label held; the 2024 source intentionally reports Tilapia sp.

gapanCrosswalk.finding: These Maragondon River stations do not establish that any point falls on, or corresponds to, the one-kilometer Gapan/Sapang Adopt-a-Waterbody segment. No Gapan channel or station endpoint was supplied by this article.

limitations: The 2019 study-derived Oreochromis niloticus label remains unverified at specimen level; no diagnostic identification protocol or voucher/catalog number was independently confirmed.
The publisher's 2019 issue is marked Open Access but also displays an all-rights-reserved notice; no item-specific reuse permission was verified.
Direct retrieval of the publisher-hosted PDF timed out in this follow-up. The station table was reviewed through the publisher-indexed PDF text, and no local copy was retained.
Sampling points do not trace or delimit the river, verify current conditions, establish fishing access, or prove fish absence elsewhere.
The 2024 paper's exact upstream coordinate match may reflect reuse of the same study locality; it is not an independent taxonomic verification.
No source crosswalk connects the Maragondon station points to Gapan/Sapang River.
nextAction: Keep all nine coordinates in the internal research record pending rights review. Continue the Gapan/Sapang search for an authorized segment endpoint or station-to-channel crosswalk and waterbody-specific dated fish evidence; do not use this Maragondon River paper to fill the Gapan gap.
